description: Defines ORM models for a recipe management system using SQLAlchemy, including User, Recipe, Tag, RecipeTag, and Favorite classes.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for ORM models using SQLAlchemy's DeclarativeBase.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user with email, password, display name, activity status, and creation timestamp; related to recipes and favorites.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a recipe with title, description, ingredients, steps, timestamps, and relationships to author, tags, and favorites.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Represents a tag with a unique name, used for categorizing recipes.

classes.name: RecipeTag
classes.description: Associative entity linking recipes and tags with a unique constraint on the pair.

classes.name: Favorite
classes.description: Represents a user's favorite recipe with timestamp, linking user and recipe with a unique constraint.
